name: Chainabuse (TRM Labs scam reports)
tier_rationale: TRM Labs, Inc. is an established company and P204 recorded tier trusted, but P304 cond 5 lists Chainabuse as community: the strictest reading (community) applies to a service whose reports are user-submitted (P204 cond 3; a fragment may only be stricter).

reliability.justification: User-submitted scam reports, unverified (P204 cond 3): one report is suspicious (low), >= 3 reports or a verified/trusted flag is fraud (medium) (P204 cond 4).

chainabuse.description: Chainabuse API key (HTTP Basic with the key as username; verify the scheme when the key is issued)
chainabuse.plan_hint: the key does not license business use: reports_api is noncommercial, so under corporate it runs only with a licence_allow entry backed by TRM Labs' written commercial permission (P204 cond 2)

reports_api.title: Chainabuse reports API v0 (scam reports per address or domain)

terms.quote: solely for your personal, non-commercial use

reports_api.notes: Quote: Chainabuse Terms of Use (TRM Labs, last updated January 20, 2025) as recorded by the council (P204 cond 2) and re-checked 2026-11-26 in the terms PDF linked from chainabuse.com. Research C0475 (verified_needs_key 401). api.chainabuse.com/v0/reports?address={a}[&page=1&perPage=50] (domains accepted) with a page cap; addresses are validated by the core validators (P217) before sending (P204 cond 1). Reports are user-submitted: 'N community reports (unverified)'; free-text descriptions masked and kept as short excerpts (P204 cond 3). Success, empty and 401 fixtures are captured with the key (P204 cond 5). Used by chainabuse.
reports_api.licensed_alternative: TRM Labs' written commercial permission recorded as a licence_allow entry (P204 cond 2); without it the manual Chainabuse address-page link (trm_chainabuse.address_pages).

address_pages.title: Chainabuse address pages www.chainabuse.com/address/{a} (manual pivot links, SPA)

terms.quote: Without a key or licence: the manual Chainabuse address-page link (SPA).

address_pages.notes: Quote: binding council text (P204 cond 5); research C0503 terms 'each site ToS' (verified_live 200). www.chainabuse.com/address/{address}: a single-page app routed to the unverified pack with the community badge (P216 cond 10, P304 cond 12); never fetched. Used by pivots_crypto and by chainabuse as its manual link when skipped.

notes: Shared seed for batches p2-G09-1, p2-G14-2 (P204, P216): batches only extend it (trm_chainabuse__<suffix>.json: extra sources and error markers). www.chainabuse.com is the pivot template host of P216 (it redirects to the apex). Quota: a standard API key has 'a usage limit of 10 calls per month (1 call= maximum of 50 reports)' (Chainabuse API documentation, checked 2026-11-26) -> key budget at 80%.
